content.json:
# CAN Security Operations Dashboard
Care Access Navigator — Azure subscription 1. Sources: Microsoft Defender for Cloud (threat detection), Azure Activity Log (control plane, *CloudTrail equivalent*), VM auth logs via Azure Monitor Agent, VNet flow logs via Traffic Analytics, Azure Policy.

content.query:
union
 (AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and OperationNameValue has 'securityRules' and ActivityStatusValue == 'Success' | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='NSG rule changes (7d)'),
 (AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and OperationNameValue has 'listKeys' and ActivityStatusValue == 'Success' | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Storage key retrievals (7d)'),
 (AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.Authorization/policies/deny/action' | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Requests denied by policy (7d)'),
 (AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and OperationNameValue has 'roleAssignments/write' and ActivityStatusValue == 'Success' | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='RBAC role grants (7d)'),
 (Syslog | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Facility in ('auth','authpriv') and SyslogMessage has_any ("not allowed because","Invalid user","Connection closed by authenticating user","Failed password","authentication failure","maximum authentication attempts") | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Failed SSH auth events (7d)')
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Key security metrics

content.query: securityresources | where type == 'microsoft.security/locations/alerts' | extend Severity=tostring(properties.Severity) | summarize Alerts=count() by Severity
content.title: Defender for Cloud alerts by severity

content.query: securityresources | where type == 'microsoft.security/locations/alerts' | extend Time=todatetime(properties.TimeGeneratedUtc), Alert=tostring(properties.AlertDisplayName), Severity=tostring(properties.Severity), Entity=tostring(properties.CompromisedEntity), Status=tostring(properties.Status) | project Time, Severity, Alert, Entity, Status | order by Time desc | take 25
content.title: Defender for Cloud alerts (latest 25)

content.query: Syslog | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and Facility in ('auth','authpriv') and SyslogMessage has_any ("not allowed because","Invalid user","Connection closed by authenticating user","Failed password","authentication failure","maximum authentication attempts") | summarize Attempts=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), HostName
content.title: Failed / blocked SSH authentications (VM auth log)

content.query: AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and ActivityStatusValue == 'Success' | where OperationNameValue has_any ('securityRules','roleAssignments','listKeys','policyAssignments','policyExemptions','regenerateKey') | project TimeGenerated, Operation=OperationNameValue, Resource=tostring(split(_ResourceId,'/')[-1]), Caller, CallerIpAddress | order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Security-relevant control-plane changes (Activity Log)

content.query: AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and OperationNameValue =~ 'Microsoft.Authorization/policies/deny/action' | extend a=parse_json(tostring(Properties_d.policies)) | mv-expand a | summarize Denials=count() by Assignment=tostring(a.policyAssignmentName)
content.title: Requests blocked by Azure Policy

content.query: NTANetAnalytics | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and SubType == 'FlowLog' | summarize Flows=sum(AllowedInFlows+DeniedInFlows+AllowedOutFlows+DeniedOutFlows) by FlowStatus, FlowDirection
content.title: Network flows by status (VNet flow logs / Traffic Analytics)

content.query: NTANetAnalytics | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and SubType == 'FlowLog' and DestPort == 22 and FlowDirection == 'Inbound' | summarize Flows=sum(AllowedInFlows+DeniedInFlows) by SrcIp=coalesce(SrcIp, tostring(SrcPublicIps)), FlowStatus | top 10 by Flows
content.title: Top inbound sources to management port 22

content.query: policyresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates' | extend a=tostring(properties.policyAssignmentName), s=tostring(properties.complianceState) | summarize NonCompliant=dcountif(tostring(properties.resourceId), s=='NonCompliant'), Compliant=dcountif(tostring(properties.resourceId), s=='Compliant') by Assignment=a
content.title: Azure Policy compliance (non-compliant resources per assignment)
